blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Despite their remarkable capabilities, large foundation models (LFMs) remain susceptible to adversarial manipulation. Current safety intervention methods primarily rely on the \textit{locality hypothesis}, rigidly suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, harmful semantics manifest as distributed, cross-layer circuits, rendering localized ablations both brittle against complex jailbreaks and detrimental to general utility. To bridge this gap, we propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level safety intervention framework that explicitly traces safety-relevant causal routing pathways activated under harmful inputs and realigns their unsafe activation states. Our framework operates in a \textit{Discover-Trace-Realign} paradigm: it first pinpoints a sensitive onset layer via attention divergence and disentangles dense activations into interpretable routing features using sparse autoencoders (SAEs). Subsequently, it maps these features to downstream causal circuits via feature influence scores (FIS). Crucially, departing from rigid suppression paradigms, TraceRouter++ introduces a constrained optimal transport (OT)-based soft routing realignment. By formulating safety intervention as a tractable coordinate-wise marginal optimal transport approximation, our method redirects unsafe activation marginals toward safe-reference marginals within causally identified routing subspaces while preserving non-selected coordinates at the intervention point. This mechanism safely redirects malicious semantic flows while leaving orthogonal computational routes intact. Extensive experiments across representative large language models (LLMs), multimodal large language models (MLLMs), and diffusion models (DMs) show that TraceRouter++ outperforms evaluated baselines, improving adversarial robustness while maintaining a favorable safety-utility trade-off. WARNING: This paper contains unsafe model responses.
blocks.zh: 大型基础模型(LFMs)尽管能力显著,但仍易受对抗性操纵。 目前的安全干预方法主要依赖于\textit{地点假说},刚性地压制孤立的神经元或特征. 然而,有害的语义表现为分布式的跨层电路,使局部化的沸腾既不利于复杂的越狱,也不利于一般用途。 为了弥补这一差距,我们提议Texe Router++,即一个路由级安全干预框架,明确追踪在有害投入下启动的安全相关因果路径,并调整其不安全的激活状态。 我们的框架在\textit{Discover-Traces-Realign}范式中运作:它首先通过注意力差异确定一个敏感的触发层,并利用稀疏的自动编码器(SAEs)将密集的激活分解为可解释的路由特性。 随后,它通过特征影响分数(FIS)将这些特征映射到下游因果电路. 关键的是,从僵硬的抑制模式出发,Trace Router++引入了一种限制性的最佳运输(OT)软路线调整。 通过将安全干预制定为可引导的坐标-明智的边缘最佳运输近似,我们的方法将不安全的激活边缘转向因果识别的路由子空间的安全参考边缘,同时在干预点保留非选定的坐标。 这种机制安全地引导恶意语义流,同时使正交计算路线完好无损. 跨越具有代表性的大型语言模型(LLMs)、多式联运大型语言模型(MLLMs)和传播模型(DMs)的广泛实验表明,TraceRouter++的绩效超过了对基线的评价,提高了对抗力,同时保持了有利的安全-效用权衡。 警告:本文包含不安全的模型响应.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: The widespread deployment of large foundation models (LFMs), spanning large language models (LLMs) [ 88 , 78 , 92 , 27 ] , multimodal large language models (MLLMs) [ 79 , 82 , 33 , 91 ] , and diffusion models (DMs) [ 18 , 49 , 11 , 66 , 65 ] , is accompanied by significant adversarial risks [ 77 , 95 , 43 ] . Existing safety intervention methods [ 29 ] primarily rely on the locality hypothesis , attempting to mitigate harmful semantics by suppressing isolated neurons or features. However, semantic representations within LFMs are inherently distributed [ 17 ] . Harmful concepts are rarely confined to isolated components; instead, they propagate through complex, cross-layer topological trajectories [ 4 ] . Consequently, localized interventions act as isolated roadblocks, unable to contain semantic leakage under sophisticated adversarial attacks. Furthermore, forcibly severing entangled neural components inevitably disrupts benign computations and degrades general utility. These critical vulnerabilities necessitate a structural paradigm shift from rigid node suppression toward continuous routing interventions. By smoothly realigning malicious semantic propagation, this approach mitigates harmful outputs while limiting distortion to the representation manifold.
blocks.zh: 广泛部署大基础模型,跨越大语言模型[88,78,92,27],多式大语言模型[79,82,33,91],传播模型[DMs][18,49,11,66,65],伴有重大的对抗风险[77,95,43]. 现有的安全干预方法[29]主要依靠局部假说,试图通过压制孤立的神经元或特征来减轻有害的语义. 然而,LFMs中的语义表述本质上是分布的[17]. 有害的概念很少局限于孤立的组成部分;相反,它们通过复杂、跨层地形轨迹传播[4]。 因此,局部干预是孤立的路障,在尖端的对抗性攻击下无法控制语义渗漏。 此外,强行切断缠绕的神经元件不可避免地会破坏良性计算并降低一般效用. 这些关键的脆弱性要求从僵硬的节点压制转向持续的路线干预。 这种方法通过顺利调整恶意语义传播,减轻了有害产出,同时将扭曲限制在表达方式上。

blocks.en: Current internal interventions [ 29 , 74 , 93 ] typically impose rigid ablations on specific features or local neurons under the assumption that harmful semantics are spatially localized (see Fig. 1 (a)). This component-centric perspective, however, overlooks the cross-layer evolution of representations: adversarial semantics exist in superposition across layers and propagate along structured computational circuits. Recent neuroscientific evidence [ 39 , 34 ] further corroborates that complex behaviors emerge from topological circuits rather than isolated nodes. Thus, ablating individual units often fails to comprehensively regulate the holistic flow of malicious information, leaving models vulnerable to adversarial semantic escape . Furthermore, indiscriminate rigid suppression can damage benign orthogonal pathways, degrading general performance. Effective safety alignment, therefore, suggests a departure from forcibly severing connections, pointing towards a necessity for continuous, optimal transport [ 53 ] (OT)-driven soft realignment over these underlying causal pathways.
blocks.zh: 目前的内部干预[29、74、93] 通常对具体特征或局部神经元施加僵硬的擦伤,假定有害语义是空间局部化的(见图1(a))。 然而,这种以构件为中心的视角忽略了表达式的跨层演变:对立语义存在于跨层叠加中,并沿结构化计算电路传播. 最近的神经科学证据[39,34]进一步证实了复杂的行为来自地形电路而不是孤立的节点. 因此,拆散单个单位往往无法全面规范恶意信息的整体流动,使模型容易发生对抗语义逃逸。 此外,不分青红皂白的僵硬压制可能损害良性正交途径,降低一般性能。 因此,有效的安全协调意味着偏离了强行切断连接的做法,表明有必要对这些基本因果路径进行持续、最佳的运输[53](OT)驱动的软调整。

blocks.en: Motivated by these mechanistic insights, we formalize the routing-level representation hypothesis: safety-critical semantics in LFMs are encoded and transmitted via distributed causal routing circuits rather than localized units. Crucially, abruptly disconnecting these highly entangled circuits tends to disrupt orthogonal benign computations. Accordingly, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (b), we posit that formulating safety intervention as a distribution alignment problem, specifically, executing an OT-driven soft realignment over these estimated routing pathways, provides a theoretically grounded and empirically robust approach for enhancing safety control while mitigating unintended utility degradation.
blocks.zh: 基于这些机械化的洞察力,我们正式确定了路由级代表假说:LFMs中的安全临界语义通过分布因果路由电路而不是局部单元编码和传输. 关键是,突然断开这些高度缠绕的电路,往往会扰乱正统的良性计算。 因此,如图1(b)所示,我们假定,将安全干预作为分配协调问题,具体而言,针对这些估计的路线路径实施OT驱动的软调整,为加强安全控制、同时缓解无意的公用事业退化提供了理论依据和经验上强有力的方法。

blocks.en: To address this problem, we propose TraceRouter++, a generalized routing-level safety intervention framework operating through a universal Discover–Trace–Realign paradigm. In the discovery stage, we localize a sensitive onset layer, defined as the earliest representational bottleneck where harmful-context-specific attention divergence becomes salient. Subsequently, we employ a Top- K K sparse autoencoder (SAE) [ 15 ] to decompose dense layer activations into interpretable, sparse routing features, thereby isolating components that exhibit preferential activation under malicious induction relative to benign queries. In the tracing stage, we project these sparse features back into the backbone and utilize zero-out interventions to quantify the feature influence score (FIS) across downstream layers. This causal tracing fundamentally moves beyond localized node analysis, enabling the precise reconstruction of cross-layer computational circuits associated with unsafe behaviors. Finally, in the realignment stage, TraceRouter++ supersedes heuristic rigid suppression with an OT-inspired coordinate-wise soft routing policy. By framing the intervention as a tractable, coordinate-wise transport problem under a conditional independence assumption, TraceRouter++ smoothly maps unsafe activation distributions along identified malicious pathways toward safe reference distributions. This paradigm shift, from rigid neural ablation to continuous distributional redirection, effectively curtails adversarial propagation while better preserving the underlying representation manifold in our evaluations.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们提议通过通用的Discover-Trace-Realign范式,建立一个通用的路由级安全干预框架。 在发现阶段,我们确定一个敏感发作层的位置,该层被定义为最早的表示瓶颈,其中有害-特定文字的注意力差异变得明显。 随后,我们使用Top-K 稀疏自动编码器(SAE)[15]将稠密层激活分解为可解释的,稀疏的路由特性,从而隔离在恶意诱导下相对于良性查询优先激活的组件. 在追踪阶段,我们将这些稀疏的特征重新投射到骨干中,并利用零退出的干预措施,量化地物下游各层的特征影响得分。 这种因果追踪从根本上超越了局部节点分析,使得与不安全行为相关的跨层计算电路得以精确重建. 最后,在调整阶段,TraceRouter++用OT启发式协调式软路线政策取代了Heuristic僵化抑制。 Trace Router++在有条件的独立假设下,将干预设定为可引导、协调的运输问题,沿已查明的安全参考分布的恶意路径,平稳地绘制不安全的激活分布图。 这种范式的转变,从僵硬的神经衰竭到持续的分布性重定向,有效地遏制了对抗性的传播,同时更好地保留了我们评价中的基本代表性。

blocks.en: We highlight the following contributions of this extended work [ 67 ] : • We propose TraceRouter++, a routing-level intervention framework evaluated across representative LLM, MLLM, and diffusion architectures. It introduces a systematic “Discover–Trace–Realign” paradigm to explicitly identify and redirect harmful information flows within LFMs. • We introduce a novel OT-inspired soft routing mechanism. By formulating safety intervention as a constrained distribution alignment problem, this approach maps unsafe activation distributions toward safer reference distributions, mitigating malicious concepts while alleviating the catastrophic utility degradation often associated with brittle hard-pruning. • We seamlessly integrate SAEs [ 15 ] with FIS to facilitate fine-grained feature disentanglement, enabling the precise estimation of intervention-sensitive causal propagation paths at the routing level. • Extensive evaluations across diverse generative architectures demonstrate that our framework significantly improves adversarial robustness, consistently establishing a highly favorable safety-utility Pareto frontier compared to the evaluated baselines.
blocks.zh: 我们强调这一扩大工作的以下贡献[67]: 我们提议利用具有代表性的LLM、MLLM和传播架构来评估TraceRouter++,这是一个路由级干预框架。 它引入了一个系统化的“发现-追踪-调整”模式,以明确识别和调整LFM内部的有害信息流动。 我们引入了一种新型的OT启发式软导线机制. 这种方法将安全干预确定为限制分发的调整问题,从而将不安全的激活分配图绘制成更安全的参考分配图,减轻恶意概念,同时减轻经常与粗糙的硬喷发有关的灾难性效用退化。 我们无缝地将SAEs [15] 与FIS整合,以促进精细的特征分解,从而能够准确估计出在路线一级对干预敏感的因果传播路径。 • 对各种基因结构的广泛评价表明,我们的框架大大改进了对抗性强,与评估的基线相比,一贯确立了非常有利的安全实用性-Pareto前沿。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Safety Intervention in Large Foundation Models
blocks.zh: II-A 大型基础模型的安全干预

blocks.en:
Safety alignment mechanisms for large foundation models (LFMs) span diverse modalities to mitigate adversarial risks. In natural language processing, training-time alignments like RLHF [ 52 ] and DPO [ 57 ] optimize generation toward human preferences, whereas inference-time defenses such as circuit breaker (CB) [ 94 ] and safety-specific neuron ablation [ 90 ] explicitly disrupt malicious representations. In the vision domain, diffusion model (DM) interventions range from inference-time guidance (e.g., SLD [ 62 ] ) to closed-form parameter editing methods like ESD [ 19 ] , UCE [ 20 ] , and MACE [ 46 ] , which mathematically update weight matrices to execute mass concept erasure. Furthermore, to secure multimodal large language models (MLLMs), approaches such as ECSO [ 26 ] neutralize visual threats via image-to-text transformation, CoCA [ 21 ] recalibrates representations constitutionally, and fine-grained token- or neuron-level methods like SafePTR [ 10 ] and SGM [ 74 ] aim to intercept malicious logic pathways.
Crucially, a fundamental limitation of many of these lightweight editing and fine-grained methods is their implicit reliance on the locality hypothesis, which assumes that harmful concepts are spatially confined. Recent studies demonstrate that such localized erasures are frequently circumvented by sophisticated adversarial prompts [ 54 ] and often introduce unintended side effects [ 61 ] , leaving multimodal systems particularly vulnerable to complex jailbreaks [ 44 ] . This over-reliance on semantic locality tends to result in incomplete suppression and semantic leakage. Simultaneously, indiscriminately ablating these components risks degrading benign generation fidelity by rigidly disrupting polysemantic units and orthogonal computational routes.
blocks.zh:
大型基础模型的安全协调机制涉及各种减轻对抗风险的方式。 在自然语言处理中,像RLHF[52]和DPO[57]这样的训练时间对接优化了人类喜好的生成,而像断路器(CB)[94]和安全特有的神经元衰减[90]这样的推论时间防御则明确干扰恶意表达. 在视觉领域,传播模型(DM)干预从推论时间指导(如SLD[62])到封闭式参数编辑方法,如ESD[19],UCE[20],以及MACE[46],这些方法在数学上更新权重矩阵,以执行质量概念消除. 此外,为了保证多式大型语言模型(MLLM),ECSO[26]等方法通过图像对文本的转换来消除视觉威胁,CoCA[21]重新校正表达方式符合宪法,SafePTR[10]和SGM[74]等精细刻度的符号或神经元级方法旨在拦截恶意逻辑路径.
关键是,这些轻量级编辑和精细处理方法中的一个根本限制是它们隐含地依赖地点假设,即有害概念在空间上是受限制的。 最近的研究表明,这种局部化的消除往往被复杂的对抗性诱因所绕过[54],并往往产生意想不到的副作用[61],使多式联运系统特别容易发生复杂的越狱事件[44]。 这种对语义位置的过度依赖往往导致抑制不完全和语义渗漏. 同时,不分青红皂白地搅拌这些部件,可能会通过僵硬地破坏多语系单元和正向计算途径而降低良性生成的忠诚。

blocks.en: II-B Causal Routing Analysis of Neural Representations
blocks.zh: II-B 神经特征的因果循环分析

blocks.en:
Emerging research in mechanistic interpretability posits that semantic behaviors in deep neural networks emerge from distributed computations along cross-layer routing paths rather than isolated nodes. This structural perspective is vital for comprehensive model analysis [ 51 ] . In Transformer architectures, which underpin LLMs and MLLMs, multiple interacting components dynamically assemble into functional topological circuits. By uncovering influential neuron paths [ 75 ] , researchers have mapped how specific concepts are encoded in superposition and expressed through structured, often redundant, computational routing paths.
This structural perspective extends seamlessly to visual generation. Prior studies on diffusion models [ 30 , 9 ] demonstrate that textual concepts guide image synthesis through multi-layer attention trajectories and intermediate feature routing paths. These works confirm that modifying attention patterns or feature flows can fundamentally alter semantic expression. Parallel findings in LLMs [ 75 ] further indicate that because semantic behaviors are mediated by overlapping cross-layer pathways, harmful concepts can persist or easily re-emerge if interventions are strictly localized. Despite these diagnostic advances in interpretability across diverse architectures, most existing safety interventions have yet to fully integrate these causal semantic routing paths into their defensive mechanisms. This creates a critical gap between routing-level mechanistic understanding and practical, robust safety control. Mechanistic interpretability has enabled the localization of behaviorally relevant layers, sparse features, and cross-layer circuits through attention analysis, sparse representation learning, and activation-based causal tracing [ 51 , 75 ] . In parallel, representation-steering and concept-erasure methods control model behavior by modifying activation directions, projecting out concept information, or suppressing selected components [ 93 , 7 ] . Building on these advances, TraceRouter++ connects cross-layer causal route identification with coordinate-wise optimal transport, enabling unsafe activation distributions to be realigned toward safe references within the identified routing subspace.
blocks.zh:
机械解释性方面的新兴研究假定,深神经网络中的语义行为是沿着跨层路径而不是孤立的节点从分布式计算中产生的。 这种结构视角对综合模型分析至关重要[51]. 在支撑LLMs和MLLMs的变形器架构中,多个相互作用的组件动态地组装成功能性的地形电路. 通过发现有影响力的神经元路径[75],研究人员绘制了具体概念是如何在叠加中编码并通过结构化的,往往是冗余的计算路径表达的.
这种结构视角无缝地延伸至视觉生成. 之前关于传播模型的研究[30,9]表明,文字概念通过多层次的注意力轨迹和中间特征的路径来指导图像合成. 这些作品证实修改关注模式或特征流可以从根本上改变语义表达. LLMS[75]中的平行发现进一步表明,由于语义行为通过重叠的跨层路径进行调解,如果干预措施严格本地化,有害的概念可能持续存在或容易重新出现. 尽管在各种结构的可解释性方面取得了这些诊断性进展,但大多数现有的安全干预措施尚未将这些因果语义的路径充分纳入其防御机制。 这在路由层面的机械理解与实际,有力的安全控制之间造成了关键差距. 机械解释性通过注意力分析,表示性学习和基于激活的因果关系追踪[51,75],使得行为相关层,特征稀少,跨层电路的本地化得以实现. 同时,通过修改激活方向,投射概念信息,或压制选定的组件[93,7],来进行表达-探究和概念-鉴赏方法控制模型行为. 在这些进展的基础上,TraceRouter++将跨层因果路由识别与坐标-明智的最佳运输连接起来,使得不安全的激活分布能够重新调整到已查明的路由子空间的安全参考.

blocks.en: II-C Optimal Transport in Representation Learning
blocks.zh: II-C 代表性学习的最佳运输

blocks.en: Optimal transport (OT) [ 53 ] provides a principled mathematical framework for comparing and mapping probability distributions. In representation learning, OT-based methods leveraging the Wasserstein distance [ 5 ] have been extensively applied to domain adaptation [ 13 ] , generative modeling [ 5 ] , and cross-modal alignment [ 2 ] . For instance, OT has proven highly effective in bridging structural gaps, aligning neural graph representations [ 72 , 85 ] , and uncovering complex structural correspondences between human visual perception and LLMs [ 83 ] . By formulating feature alignment as a transportation problem, these approaches facilitate smooth distribution mappings between disparate latent spaces while preserving underlying geometric and topological structures.
blocks.zh: 优化迁移(OT)[53]为比较和绘制概率分布提供了原则数学框架. 在代表性学习中,利用Wasserstein距离的OT方法[5]被广泛应用于域内适应[13]、基因模型[5]和跨模式对齐[2]。 例如,OT已证明在弥合结构差距、调整神经图表达[72、85]以及发现人类视觉感知与LLMS[83]之间复杂的结构对应方面非常有效。 这些方法将特征调整作为一个运输问题,有助于在不同的潜在空间之间平稳分布图,同时保留基本的几何和地形结构。

blocks.en: Despite its tremendous success in macroscopic data alignment, the potential of OT for internal causal routing realignment remains largely underexplored. Recently, pioneering works have applied OT to the internal architectures of LLMs: OpT-DeUS [ 8 ] fuses Transformer blocks to mitigate permutation mismatches, OTPO [ 40 ] employs unbalanced OT for token-level weighting, and multi-level optimal transport (MOT) [ 64 ] infers soft, globally consistent layer-to-layer couplings. Conversely, foundation model safety interventions predominantly rely on rigid ablations or orthogonal projections [ 93 , 7 ] , which can inadvertently disrupt benign feature distributions and trigger capability degradation. To address this limitation, our work introduces an OT-based soft routing realignment strategy specifically designed for safety interventions over causal semantic routing paths. By estimating coordinate-wise OT maps between unsafe and safe activations, our method realigns these paths toward safe representational manifolds, enabling targeted concept neutralization while better preserving the model’s general generative utility.
blocks.zh: 尽管在宏观数据调整方面取得了巨大成功,但OT在内部因果路由调整方面的潜力仍然在很大程度上没有得到充分发挥。 最近,开创性的工作将OT应用于LLMs的内部架构:OpT-DeUS [8] 引信变压器区块以缓解变压器不匹配现象,OTPO [40] 使用不平衡的OT进行标值级权重,多级最佳运输(MOT) [64] 推断软的,全球一致的层层对层耦合. 反之,基础性模型安全干预主要依赖于硬化的擦伤或正向预测[93,7],这可能会无意中扰乱良性特征分布并引发能力退化。 为了消除这一局限性,我们的工作引入了一项基于OT的软路线调整战略,专门针对因果语义路线的安全干预。 通过对不安全和安全激活之间的协调式OT地图进行估计,我们的方法将这些路径重新调整为安全代表的多面体,从而实现目标明确的概念中和,同时更好地维护模型的一般基因效用。

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Fig. 2 , we propose TraceRouter++, a routing level safety intervention framework applicable to diverse large foundation model architectures. We first mathematically formalize safety intervention as a constrained distribution alignment problem over causal semantic routing subspaces (detailed in Section III-A ). To resolve this problem, the methodology operates through a systematic pipeline consisting of three stages designed to explicitly identify, trace, and realign the specific computational routing paths associated with harmful semantics.
In the discovery stage, TraceRouter++ pinpoints a sensitive onset layer by analyzing attention divergence. It then employs a Top- K K sparse autoencoder to disentangle dense layer activations into interpretable routing features (presented in Section III-B ). During the tracing stage, these sparse features are projected back into the latent space to monitor their subsequent propagation. Within this process, the causal influence of each routing node is quantitatively evaluated using the feature influence score, as outlined in Section III-C .
Finally, in the realignment stage, TraceRouter++ eschews rigid suppression in favor of a soft routing realignment driven by optimal transport. By estimating marginal transport maps between unsafe and safe activation distributions, the framework seamlessly maps the identified causal semantic routing paths toward safe representational manifolds (discussed in Section III-D ). This distributional redirection mitigates the propagation of malicious semantics while strictly preserving orthogonal computational routes. The mathematical intuition and geometric guarantees underpinning this transport mechanism are formally established in Section III-E .

blocks.en: Models. To verify the architectural universality of TraceRouter++, we conduct evaluations across a diverse suite of large foundation models, as summarized in Table I . Our selection encompasses representative large language models (LLMs) such as LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] and Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] , alongside multimodal large language models (MLLMs) like LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 42 ] , MiniGPT-4-7B [ 91 ] and DeepSeek-VL2 [ 80 ] . For visual generation, we extend our analysis to various diffusion models (DMs), including Stable Diffusion 1.4 [ 59 ] , FLUX.1-Dev [ 38 ] , AltDiffusion [ 86 ] , and Show-o2 [ 84 ] . This broad selection ensures that our routing realignment framework is effective across different modalities and computational structures.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 为了核实TraceRouter++的建筑普遍性,我们通过各种大型基础模型进行评价,见表一。 我们的选择包括具有代表性的大型语言模型,如LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [27] 和Mistral-7B-Instruct [35],与LLaVA-1.5-7B[42]、MiniGPT-4-7B[91]和DeepSeek-VL2[80]等多式联运大型语言模型并列。 对于视觉生成,我们的分析扩展到各种扩散模型(DM),包括稳定扩散1.4[59],FLUX.1-Dev[38],AltDifunation[86],以及Show-o2[84]. 这种广泛的选择确保了我们的路线调整框架在不同模式和计算结构之间有效。

blocks.en:
Datasets. Our evaluation involves an adversarial environment paired with standard capability benchmarks to measure the trade-off between safety and utility across LLMs, MLLMs, and DMs.
For LLM, we construct harmful instruction sets from AdvBench [ 95 ] and HarmBench [ 50 ] , and further evaluate robustness against both automated gradient-driven attacks, including GCG [ 95 ] and AutoDAN [ 43 ] , and manual pattern-based jailbreaks, including Template [ 81 ] and Prefill [ 81 ] attacks. To evaluate benign behavior and utility preservation, we use XSTEST [ 60 ] for over-refusal analysis and Global-MMLU-Lite [ 68 ] for general reasoning capability.
For MLLMs, we evaluate safety and jailbreak robustness using FigStep [ 25 ] , which emphasizes image-side jailbreak attacks, and JailbreakV-28K [ 47 ] , which covers transferred text-side jailbreak scenarios under diverse visual inputs. General multimodal utility is measured on MMBench [ 45 ] .
For DMs, we assess explicit and violent content mitigation using the I2P-N and I2P-V subsets of I2P [ 62 ] , and evaluate adversarial robustness on P4D [ 12 ] and Ring-A-Bell [ 73 ] . Meanwhile, generation fidelity is monitored on MS COCO [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh:
数据集. 我们的评价涉及一种具有标准能力基准的对抗性环境,以衡量各地方政府、地方政府、地方政府和地方政府机构的安全性和效用之间的权衡。
就LLM而言,我们从Adv Bench [95] 和Harm Bench [50] 构筑有害的指令集,并进一步评价强性,以对付自动梯度驱动攻击,包括GCG [95]和AutoDAN [43],以及人工模式式越狱,包括模板[81]和Prefill [81]攻击。 为了评价良性行为和效用保全,我们使用XSTEST [60] 进行过度反证分析,并使用Global-MMLU-Lite [68] 进行一般推理能力.
对于MLLM,我们用强调图像侧越狱攻击的FigStep [25] 和JailbreakV-28K [47] 来评价安全和越狱的坚韧性,这些坚固性涵盖了在各种视觉投入下转移的文本侧越狱情景. 通用多式联运通用性在MMBench上测量 [45].
就模式草案而言,我们利用I2P[62]的I2P-N和I2P-V子集评估明确和暴力内容的缓解,并评价P4D[12]和Ring-A-Bell[73]的对抗力。 同时,在MS COCO上监测一代忠诚度[41].

blocks.en: Metrics. We adopt the defense success rate (DSR) as the primary metric to quantify the proportion of adversarial attempts successfully mitigated by our framework. To ensure objective and reliable semantic judgment, we employ Claude 3.5 Sonnet [ 3 ] and GPT-4 [ 1 ] as automated evaluators, supplemented by manual human verification for ambiguous edge cases. For utility preservation, we report the over-refusal rate (ORR) [ 14 ] and general accuracy to locate the safety and utility Pareto frontier. In the visual domain, specialized tools such as NudeNet [ 6 ] are utilized for content detection, while Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) [ 32 ] measures the proximity of the intervened generation distribution to the original benign distribution. We additionally report CLIP Score (CS) [ 31 ] to measure text-image alignment in benign generation.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们采用国防成功率作为衡量我们框架成功减轻的对抗性企图比例的主要衡量标准。 为了确保客观和可靠的语义判断,我们雇用克劳德·3.5·索内特[3]和GPT-4[1]作为自动评价员,并辅之以对模棱两可的边缘病例进行人工人力核查。 为了维护公用设施,我们报告过度反驳率(ORR)[14]和确定Pareto边界的安全性和公用设施的一般准确性。 在视觉领域,诸如NudeNet[6]等专门工具被用于内容检测,而Fréchet Inception District(FID)[32]测量干涉生成分布与原始良性分布的距离. 我们另外报告CLIP分数(CS)[31],以在良性生成中衡量文本图像的一致.

blocks.en: Hyperparameters. To achieve precise causal feature disentanglement, we explicitly train a Top- K K sparse autoencoder (SAE) [ 15 ] on the intermediate layer representations. This architecture is configured with an expansion factor of four and optimized via the Adam algorithm [ 36 ] using a learning rate of 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} and a batch size of 4096 4096 , guided by a mean squared error reconstruction loss. The exact number of selected sensitive routing features K K is determined by identifying the elbow point of the weighted frequency score (WFS) [ 29 ] ranking curve. This specific mathematical threshold marks the transition where high-response hub features enter the long-tail feature distribution. To characterize experimental variability, we repeat the main TraceRouter++ evaluations in Tables II – VII and the ablation comparisons in Tables VIII – XII using five seeds. These entries are reported as mean ± \pm sample standard deviation; other results retain their original reporting format. Finally, all optimization and inference procedures are executed on a single NVIDIA A6000 GPU to ensure rigorous and fair computational comparisons.

LLMs. We benchmark the defensive capabilities of TraceRouter++ on LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] and Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] against state of the art interventions including HumorReject [ 81 ] and Circuit Breaker [ 94 ] . As detailed in Table II , our evaluation covers gradient driven attacks (GCG [ 95 ] and AutoDAN [ 43 ] ) alongside manual pattern injections (Template [ 81 ] , Prefill [ 81 ] , and their combinatorial variants).
TraceRouter++ demonstrates consistent robustness across all evaluated attack categories. Specifically, the foundational Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] model exhibits a baseline average defense success rate of 6.6%. TraceRouter++ increases this average to 98.8 ± 0.3 \pm 0.3 %, corresponding to an improvement of 92.2 percentage points. Furthermore, on the LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] architecture, our framework attains an average defense success rate of 99.5 ± 0.3 \pm 0.3 %, an improvement of 36.3 percentage points over the original model. In comparison, LEACE [ 7 ] achieves lower average defense rates of 69.0% on LLaMA3 and 21.2% on Mistral. Its mean defense success rates against AutoDAN, Template, and combined Template and Prefill attacks are 99.8 ± 0.4 \pm 0.4 %, 99.6 ± 0.5 \pm 0.5 %, and 99.4 ± 0.5 \pm 0.5 %, respectively. Across individual attack categories on both models, standard deviations do not exceed 0.7 percentage points. These results demonstrate high defense success rates across the evaluated attacks, with limited observed variability across the five seeds.

blocks.en: LLMs. Figure 4 provides a qualitative comparison of model responses to complex adversarial prompts. Unaligned LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] and Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] baselines consistently succumb to sophisticated discourse manipulation. When confronted with adversarial framing, the LLaMA3 baseline generates biased historical misinformation and hazardous infant dietary advice. Similarly, the Mistral baseline exhibits severe vulnerabilities by leaking actionable instructions for chemical synthesis and environmental sabotage, often obfuscated by superficial safety disclaimers. Conversely, TraceRouter++ decisively neutralizes concealed malicious intent across all scenarios, delivering grounded refusals anchored in objective safety reasoning. These baseline failure patterns reveal a fundamental inability to arrest harmful semantic trajectories once activated. By continuously interrupting malicious propagation strictly along causal routing pathways, our framework achieves robust structural alignment rather than relying on superficial output filtering.

blocks.en: General Utility Evaluation. Beyond adversarial robustness, we evaluate the impact of TraceRouter++ on the foundational capabilities of the aligned models. As detailed in Table VI , the five-seed evaluations show modest observed utility reductions across the evaluated modalities. Specifically, performance on Global-MMLU-Lite [ 68 ] decreases by 0.4 and 0.6 percentage points for LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] and Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] , respectively, with post-intervention accuracies of 71.1 ± 0.4 \pm 0.4 % and 62.4 ± 0.3 \pm 0.3 %. Similarly, MMBench [ 45 ] accuracy decreases 0.1, 0.5 and 0.1 percentage points for LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 42 ] , MiniGPT-4-7B [ 91 ] and DeepSeek-VL2 [ 80 ] , yielding 47.4 ± 0.2 \pm 0.2 %, 15.5 ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 % and 78.6 ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 %, respectively. MiniGPT-4’s low original accuracy limits the strength of its utility evidence when considered alone. We therefore additionally evaluate DeepSeek-VL2 [ 80 ] , whose original MMBench accuracy is 78.7%. TraceRouter++ achieves 78.6 ± 0.1 78.6\pm 0.1 % across five seeds, an observed decrease of 0.1 percentage points. For visual synthesis, we evaluate text-image alignment and generation quality on the MS COCO [ 41 ] dataset. When applied to Stable Diffusion 1.4 [ 59 ] , TraceRouter++ achieves a CLIP Score [ 31 ] of 31.08 ± 0.07 \pm 0.07 , a decrease of 0.26 from the original model, and an FID [ 32 ] of 8.62 ± 0.04 \pm 0.04 . Together with the safety results, these measurements support a favorable safety–utility trade-off on the evaluated benchmarks. They do not, by themselves, establish that downstream benign computations remain unchanged.

blocks.en: Over-Refusal Analysis on LLMs. We quantify this specificity using the over-refusal rate (ORR) [ 14 ] on the XSTEST benchmark [ 60 ] , as reported in Table VII . TraceRouter++ exhibits modest observed increases in over-refusal relative to the original instruction-tuned models. Specifically, on LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] ORR increases from 3.2% to 3.5 ± 0.3 3.5\pm 0.3 %, a rise of 0.3 percentage points. Similarly, on Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] ORR increases from 1.2% to 2.3 ± 0.3 2.3\pm 0.3 %, a rise of 1.1 percentage points. Together with the defense results, these five-seed evaluations show that TraceRouter++ improves safety while keeping the observed increase in benign-prompt refusals limited.

blocks.en: Spatial Analysis of Pixel Level Discrepancies. To rigorously examine the spatial impact of safety interventions, Figure 7 visualizes pixel-level residual maps comparing the aligned outputs against the original unaligned generation. Under benign prompt conditions, existing methods [ 19 , 20 , 37 , 62 , 46 , 24 , 48 , 28 , 29 ] produce widespread residual responses, indicating that their interventions indiscriminately perturb the visual synthesis process even in the absolute absence of unsafe concepts. When subjected to sensitive prompts, the residual patterns of these baseline frameworks remain highly diffuse, improperly extending into background regions and altering benign visual elements. These spatially dispersed perturbations directly corroborate the semantic drift phenomena observed in our prior qualitative assessments, explaining why baseline techniques inadvertently modify overall scene layouts and subject postures. In contrast, TraceRouter++ yields residual maps that are highly concentrated and exhibit significantly lower perturbation magnitudes. Spatial modifications remain localized to sensitive regions, preserving background structure and benign visual attributes. OT-driven realignment facilitates precise interventions on causal routing pathways, circumventing the broad disruption characteristic of prior methodologies.

blocks.en: Counterfactual Intervention for Routing-Path Validation. To validate the functional involvement of the identified safety-relevant routing pathways, we selectively amplify or suppress their activations. As shown in Table VIII below in this response letter, route amplification increases DSR from 63.2 % 63.2\% to 75.8 ± 1.7 % \pm 1.7\% on LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] and from 49.0 % 49.0\% to 78.6 ± 0.7 % \pm 0.7\% on LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 42 ] . Conversely, suppressing the same routes reduces DSR to 61.4 ± 1.4 % \pm 1.4\% and 18.2 ± 1.9 % \pm 1.9\% , respectively. These bidirectional counterfactual effects provide functional evidence that the identified routes participate in safety-relevant semantic processing rather than representing incidental activation correlations.

blocks.en: Comparative Analysis of Intervention Granularity. To strictly evaluate the theoretical necessity of causal semantic routing, we compare our framework against a neuron baseline that suppresses isolated activations without modeling cross-layer propagation. As illustrated in Figure 8 , while isolated neuron intervention achieves marginal success on standard benchmarks, it exhibits catastrophic degradation under complex adversarial settings. Most notably, under the Prefill attack [ 81 ] on language models and the P4D [ 12 ] prompt on diffusion architectures, the DSR of the neuron baseline plummets significantly. This severe vulnerability confirms that suppressing local nodes is insufficient; malicious semantics can effortlessly bypass isolated defenses by propagating through alternative generative pathways. In stark contrast, TraceRouter++ consistently maximizes the defense success rate across all foundational architectures. By explicitly realigning entire causal routing paths via optimal transport, our framework strictly controls the holistic information flow, effectively neutralizing distributed adversarial attacks. These ablation results definitively establish that continuous path-level distribution alignment provides profound robustness advantages over purely localized node suppression.

Necessity of Accurate Path Identification. To assess the contribution of path identification, we construct a controlled baseline applying identical intervention strength to randomly selected routing paths. As illustrated in Figure 10 , random targeting produces limited safety gains. On LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] , our framework improves the defense success rate from 63.2% to 99.5 ± 0.3 \pm 0.3 % , whereas random intervention causes a marginal decrease to 62.8%. Similarly, random path targeting yields negligible improvements on LLaVA-1.5-7B [ 42 ] (49.0% to 51.0%) and Stable Diffusion 1.4 [ 59 ] (82.2% to 84.7%), compared with TraceRouter++ results of 99.4 ± 0.1 99.4\pm 0.1 % and 99.3 ± 0.2 99.3\pm 0.2 %, respectively. This comparison supports the importance of selecting relevant intervention paths rather than applying realignment to arbitrary coordinates. We further evaluate path identification by ablating the scoring metric. The proposed scoring mechanism jointly incorporates activation frequency F F , activation intensity I I , and zero-out causal shift S S . Table XII reports five-seed comparisons of the full formulation and its reduced variants. The full F ⋅ I ⋅ S F\cdot I\cdot S achieves the highest mean defense rates among the evaluated variants across all three models. Its accuracy reductions are 0.4 and 0.1 percentage points on Global-MMLU-Lite [ 68 ] and MMBench [ 45 ] , respectively, with a 0.26 decrease in CLIP Score [ 31 ] . However, it does not maximize every utility metric: F ⋅ I F\cdot I achieves higher LLaMA3 accuracy, and the reduced variants achieve higher CLIP Scores.
On LLaVA, using F F or S S alone yields defense rates of 63.4 ± 0.8 \pm 0.8 % and 66.8 ± 0.6 \pm 0.6 %, respectively, compared with 99.4 ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 % for the full score. These results support combining activation statistics with interventional influence when selecting routing paths, while revealing trade-offs between defense performance and individual utility metrics.

blocks.en: Topological Visualization of Causal Pathways. To empirically validate our routing level representation hypothesis and geometricize the propagation of harmful semantics, Figure 11 visualizes the isolated causal trajectories originating from the sensitive onset layer. By deliberately filtering out benign units and irrelevant background connections, the visualization exposes a strictly hierarchical and tree-structured cross-layer topology across language, multimodal, and diffusion architectures. Specifically, the sensitive features at the localized onset layer act as primary routing hubs, establishing high magnitude causal connections to a distinctly sparse subset of subsequent neurons. These activations systematically branch into downstream layers, forming a highly directional routing cascade. Furthermore, the topological mapping explicitly differentiates dominant routing pathways from auxiliary connections, confirming that malicious semantic propagation is exclusively governed by an exceptionally concentrated subset of causal routes rather than diffuse layer-wide computations. The striking structural consistency of this phenomenon across fundamentally distinct foundational models definitively confirms the universality of our proposed routing level framework.
blocks.zh: 致病路径的地形视觉. 为了从经验上验证我们的路由水平表示假设,并对有害语义的传播进行几何化,图11可视化了源自敏感发端层的孤立因果轨迹. 通过刻意过滤出良性单元和不相关的背景连接,可视化暴露出一种严格分级和树状的跨层地形跨越语言,多式联运,以及扩散结构. 具体地说,局部发端层的敏感特征起到主要路由中心的作用,与一个明显稀少的随后的神经元子集建立了高度的因果关系. 这些活化物系统化地分化为下游地层,形成高度定向的路由级联. 此外,地形图明确区分了主要路径和辅助连接,确认恶意语义传播完全受特别集中的因果路径子集的制约,而不是分散的全层计算。 这一现象在根本不同的基础模式中具有显著的结构一致性,这明确证实了我们提议的路线级别框架的普遍性。

blocks.en: Architectural Generalization on Diffusion Models. To rigorously evaluate the generalization capabilities of TraceRouter++ across diverse foundational paradigms, we conduct extensive experiments on the FLUX.1 Dev [ 38 ] flow matching architecture, the multilingual AltDiffusion [ 86 ] model, and the unified multimodal Show-o2 [ 84 ] framework. As detailed in Table XIII , our optimal transport realignment consistently achieves the optimal Pareto frontier of safety and utility across all heterogeneous backbones. Regarding adversarial robustness, TraceRouter++ delivers substantial improvements in the defense success rate, elevating baseline performances by 23.1, 19.1, and 8.5 absolute points on FLUX.1 Dev [ 38 ] , AltDiffusion [ 86 ] , and Show-o2 [ 84 ] , respectively. These outcomes significantly outperform the competitive SNCE [ 29 ] baseline across all evaluated settings. Simultaneously, TraceRouter++ maintains exceptional generation quality, exhibiting negligible CLIP Score [ 31 ] degradations of merely 0.9, 0.3, and 0.1 on the respective architectures, strictly preserving superior text to image alignment compared to existing safety editing baselines. These empirical results definitively confirm our core theoretical premise. By selectively executing causal semantic realignment, the framework effectively neutralizes unsafe outputs while meticulously preserving the orthogonal generative pathways required for high-fidelity multimodal synthesis, demonstrating profound architectural universality.
blocks.zh: 关于扩散模型的建筑概论. 为了严格评价TraceRouter++在各种基本范式上的通俗化能力,我们对FLUX.1 Dev [38] 流量匹配架构、多语种AltDifmation [86] 模型以及统一的多式联运显示-o2 [84]框架进行了广泛的实验。 如表十三所详述,我们优化的运输调整始终实现所有不同骨干的安全性和实用性的最佳Pareto前沿。 关于对抗力,Trace Router++大幅提高防御成功率,将基线性能分别提高23.1、19.1和FLUX.1 Dev [38]、AltDifunation [86]和Show-o2 [84]的8.5绝对点。 这些结果大大超过了所有评价环境中具有竞争力的SNCE[29]基线。 同时,Texe Router++保持了独特的生成质量,显示CLIP分数[31]在相应架构上的降解度只有0.9、0.3和0.1,与现有的安全编辑基线相比,严格保留了优于图像对齐的文本。 这些经验性结果明确证实了我们的核心理论前提。 该框架有选择地实施因果语义调整,有效地抵消了不安全的产出,同时精心地维护高纯度多式联运所需的正统遗传途径,显示了深刻的建筑普遍性。

blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we present TraceRouter++, a routing-driven safety intervention framework designed to control harmful semantic propagation across large foundational models.
Transcending the conventional locality hypothesis, our empirical findings conclusively demonstrate that malicious behaviors are structurally encoded within distributed, cross-layer routing pathways rather than isolated neural components.
Driven by this geometric perspective, we introduce a universal three-stage pipeline to discover sensitive onset layers, trace causal semantic trajectories, and execute optimal transport-driven soft realignment strictly along these isolated routes.
Beyond establishing robustness, our theoretical formulation proves that foundational safety is most effectively achieved through continuous distribution alignment over causal pathways rather than purely localized activation suppression.
By mathematically bridging mechanistic interpretability with targeted functional control, TraceRouter++ establishes causal routing trajectories as the definitive interface for precise model intervention.
Extensive experiments across LLMs, MLLMs, and DMs confirm that TraceRouter++ significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving superior adversarial robustness and establishing the optimal safety and utility Pareto frontier.

在这项工作中,我们介绍了Trace Router++,这是一个由路由驱动的安全干预框架,旨在控制大型基本模型中有害的语义传播。
将传统的局部假说转过来,我们的经验性发现最终表明,恶意行为在分布的,跨层的路径中结构化地编码,而不是孤立的神经元件.
在这种几何视角的驱动下,我们引入了一个通用的三相管道,以发现敏感的发光层,痕量因果语义轨迹,并严格沿着这些孤立的路线执行优化的运输驱动软调.
除了建立稳健性外,我们的理论表述还证明,通过在因果路径上持续进行分布协调,而不是纯粹局部激活抑制,可以最有效地实现基本安全。
Trace Router++通过数学上将机械解释性与目标功能控制联系起来,将因果路由轨迹确定为精确模型干预的决定性界面.
跨LLMs、MLLMs和DMs的广泛实验证实,TraceRouter++大大超过现有基线,实现了优异的对抗力强,建立了最佳安全和效用Pareto前沿。

Impact of Autoencoder Expansion Factors. To evaluate the structural capacity required for effective feature disentanglement, we analyze the sparse autoencoder expansion factor across foundational architectures. Following recent SAE studies that adopt compact expansion factors of 4 × 4\times or 8 × 8\times [ 29 , 70 , 71 ] , we re-tune the SAE capacity for the OT-based TraceRouter++ pipeline and evaluate expansion factors of { 2 × , 4 × , 6 × , 8 × } \{2\times,4\times,6\times,8\times\} . blocks.en: Reliability and Computational Overhead. Table XVI reports the online inference efficiency and one-time offline costs of TraceRouter++. Request latency increases from 874.25 ± 7.71 874.25\pm 7.71 ms to 1,125.81 ± 3.68 1{,}125.81\pm 3.68 ms, corresponding to a 28.8% increase, while latency per output token rises from 27.54 ± 0.24 \pm 0.24 ms to 35.18 ± 0.12 \pm 0.12 ms. Accordingly, throughput decreases from 36.32 ± 0.32 \pm 0.32 to 28.42 ± 0.09 \pm 0.09 output tokens per second, a reduction of 21.7%. In contrast, peak GPU memory increases by only 0.07 MiB, from 15,357.24 MiB to 15,357.31 MiB. The offline stage requires 7.25 s for SAE training and 0.09 s for pathfinding, resulting in a total one-time overhead of 7.34 s. The small observed standard deviations indicate stable runtime measurements across the evaluated runs. Overall, the computational cost of TraceRouter++ is dominated by additional online latency rather than memory usage or offline preparation.

blocks.en: Following the GCG method [ 95 ] , we use the official llm-attacks implementation and AdvBench, adapting the attack to score candidate suffixes against the TraceRouter++-intervened model. We conduct this defense-aware evaluation over five seeds. As shown in Table XVII , TraceRouter++ increases DSR from 58.4 ± 1.7 % \pm 1.7\% to 73.4 ± 2.1 % \pm 2.1\% on LLaMA3-8B-Instruct [ 27 ] and from 4.8 ± 2.6 % \pm 2.6\% to 52.4 ± 1.1 % \pm 1.1\% on Mistral-7B-Instruct [ 35 ] . These results demonstrate measurable defense gains over the original models, but the resulting DSRs remain lower than those observed against standard non-adaptive attacks. The difference between the two models further indicates that adaptive robustness is architecture-dependent. Therefore, the current method does not provide universal robustness against defense-aware optimization, and improving its cross-model adaptive robustness remains an important direction for future work.
